contracts.authApiBody: Signup, login, group join requests, and admin approvals are CGA management APIs. Aidot runtime and webchat APIs remain unchanged.

openCore.body: Public CGA remains useful, while high-value commercial modules are separated.

openCore.advancedBody: Commercial module for high-value bot creation automation.
openCore.operationsBody: Commercial module for production monitoring and improvement.
openCore.entitlementBody: Commercial control module for organization and feature access.
access.title: ユーザー、ログイン、アクセス
access.body: CGA is an operating system for bot production, so user identity and permission boundaries are part of the Public Core.
access.map: Maps to Public Core: login state / roles / scopes / audit-ready actions
access.loginBody: Authenticated users can create, configure, review, deploy, or operate bots based on role.
access.rolesBody: Owner, Admin, Builder, Reviewer, Operator, and Viewer roles separate responsibilities.
access.scopesBody: Create, configure, review, deploy, user management, and API answer management scopes are explicit.
access.opsTitle: アクセス運用スナップショット
access.opsBody: The operator should see group, user, approval, and language status without opening a database or command line.
access.authFlowBody: The first access path is explicit: sign up, receive a personal group, log in, then request access to another group when needed.
access.groupUsersBody: A group owns bots and APIs. Users receive roles inside the group, and those roles decide screen access.
access.joinRequestsBody: Users can request access to another group. Approval creates a membership for that group.
access.adminRequestsBody: Admin permission requests are visible to the system admin and must be approved before privilege changes.
access.groupAccessBody: Bots and APIs are managed by group. Users in the same group can access the group bot according to group scopes and their role.
access.screenAccessBody: Screens and actions are resolved from group membership, group scopes, role scopes, and user overrides.
access.authPolicyBody: Every new user signs up into their own group first. Users can request to join another group, and empty groups are deleted automatically.
access.adminPolicyBody: The base admin user cannot be deleted. Group creation and admin permission requests require approval by the system admin.
admin.loginBody: Switch the active user and immediately recalculate group memberships, screen access, and user language.
admin.signupBody: A new user receives a personal group and becomes that group’s administrator.
admin.groupBody: Create groups and request membership using the current user session.
admin.approvalBody: Group join requests are approved by the target group administrator. Admin permission requests are approved by system admin.
apiAnswer.title: 外部API回答ソース
apiAnswer.body: API answers are used when the response is not fixed text but comes from an external business system.
apiAnswer.map: Maps to Aidot: API card / response mapping / runtime variables
apiAnswer.name: API回答名
apiAnswer.groupManagedBody: API answers belong to the group bot, not to an individual user. Secret references and response mappings are controlled by group permissions.
apiAnswer.adminBody: Register external API answers by group. These are bot assets controlled by group permissions.
apiAnswer.dynamicBody: For values that change over time, such as company revenue or net income, CGA stores the intent and API mapping, then calls the external system at answer time.
apiAnswer.metricQuestion: Question: What is this company’s latest net income?
apiAnswer.metricAnswer: Answer: Net income is shown from the latest external API response.
coverage.title: Aidot Feature Coverage
coverage.body: CGA does not remove Aidot feature screens. It relocates every needed Aidot screen into the bot-building workflow.
coverage.map: Coverage rule: all Aidot feature screens are preserved, reorganized, and mapped
coverage.createBody: Bot create, bot setup, version, language, channel defaults, user/login/roles.
coverage.configureBody: Training utterances, PDF/RAG, intent draft, intent review, answer draft.
coverage.detailBody: Intent, answer, synonym, entity, dictionary, scenario, API card, variables, Talk cards.
coverage.buildBody: NLU training, LLM NLU, RAG embedding, simulator, runtime variables, logs.
coverage.operateBody: Deploy, webchat, channels, operation version, analysis, evaluation, retrain.
coverage.ruleBody: No Aidot feature screen is removed. If a screen is not in the beginner path, it must appear in the mapped advanced or operation area.
collab.title: 共同作業プラットフォーム
collab.body: CGA is optimized for one person to build a bot in 1-2 days, while still allowing multiple people to collaborate on the same bot when needed.
collab.map: Maps to Public Core: fast solo workflow + optional team collaboration
collab.roles: 高速な単独作業を優先
collab.rolesBody: The default flow should let one builder create, configure, test, and deploy a bot quickly without collaboration overhead.
collab.assignmentsBody: When a bot grows, intents, answers, scenarios, API answers, deployments, and evaluations can be assigned to different users.
collab.reviewBody: Generated or edited content moves through review before it becomes approved bot content.
collab.locksBody: When multiple users edit, short-lived locks prevent conflicting changes on the same item.
collab.historyBody: Every important change should keep actor, time, target, before/after summary, and review result.
collab.dashboard: チームダッシュボード
collab.dashboardBody: The dashboard shows my tasks, waiting reviews, blocked items, and deployment readiness.
